author: suspector
body:
Hey, I used to play on here a lot. Not so much previously.
First off, I am just about to start my A-level exams so I will be pretty non-existent through that period. I may pop on time to time for a break but not competitively. I am slowly losing interest, my future on mc is not clear. If I do stay, I may make my own team. So basically my reliability is lacking atm.

About me:
I used to play a lot, I was a mod when the server was MCZone and for the start of Avicus, so I have some experience. I come from OCN and I consider myself a fairly big character in the competitive scene over there. I played in the first MCZone/Avicus tournament in which I was the leader of the winners, Nodus. I have also led a few OCN teams so I do have leadership qualities. I am also well contacted so I could perhaps get some more players for your team.

As for in game, due to my leadership I tend to keep calm in tight situations and I can shot call. I can play any position but I am most effective at frontline. My melee is superior to my archery, however my archery is of a decent standard. Although my melee is of a good standard atm despite my recent inactivity so it is rusty but I did get banned for hacking (kill aura I think) on an alt on this server but I am unbanned now. Offense, I am pretty slow at it, I dont act as quick in Offense when faced with some fast paced new issues. I tend to sit back and calculate what is going on, and then form a plan and follow it, although I am more used as someone to cause a distraction or to cause havoc or just generally make life easier for the offenders. As for defence, it is my weakest position and my least fsvourite. Whilst I can do it, I really don't enjoy it, so I tend to lose concentration and make sub-par defences.
